S3:17.text: And they led him forth, and ſet him without the citie: and there they ſpake to him, ſaying Saue thy life looke not backe, neither ſtay thou in al the countrie about but ſaue thy ſelfe in the mountaine, leſt thou alſo periſh withal.

S3:18.text: And Lot ſaid to them I beſeech thee my Lord,

S3:21.text: And he ſaid to him Behold alſo in this point I haue heard thy prayers, not to ouerthrow the citie for which thou haſt ſpoken.

S3:24.text: Therfore our Lord rained vpon Sodome and Gomorre brimſtone & fire from our Lord out of heauen:

S3:25.text: and he ſubuerted theſe cities, and al the countrie about, al the inhabitants of the cities, and al things that ſpring of the earth.

S3:28.text: beheld Sodome & Gomorre, and the whole land of that countrie and he ſaw the cinders riſe vp from the earth as it were the ſmoke of a fornace.

S3:30.text: And Lot aſcended out of Segor, and abode in the mountaine, his two daughters alſo with him for he was afraid to abide in Segor) and heabode in a caue him ſelfe, and his two daughters with him.

S3:31.text: And the elder ſaid to the younger Our father is old, and there is no man left on the earth, that may companie with vs after the manner of the whole earth.

S3:32.text: Come, let vs make him drunke with wine, and let vs lie with him, that we may preſerue ſeed of our father.

S9:1.text: And the two angels came to Sodome at cuen, and Lot ſitting in the gates of the citie. Who when he had ſene them, roſe vp and went to meete them:and adored proſtrate vnto the ground,

S9:12.text: And they ſaid to Lot Haſt thou here anie of thine ſonne in law, or ſonnes, or daughters, al that are thine, bring them out of this citie †

S9:13.text: for we wil deſtroy this place, for that their crye is waxen lowde before our Lord, who hath ſent vs to deſtroy them.

S9:15.text: And when it was morning, the angels vrged him, ſaying: Ariſe, take thy wife, and the two daughters which thou haſt: leaſt thou alſo periſh withal in the wickednes of the citie.

S9:18.text: And Lot ſaid to them I beſeech thee my Lord,
